vr.look: A model is a copy of something real. An ecosystem is all the living things in a place, plus the water, soil and sunlight they need.

steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set the Buffalo, Bear, Deer, Eagle and Flower Set in the park.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ needs the ___. They both need ___ (water, sunlight or soil).”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a big cat that hunts in the mountains: Mountain Lion

vr.full: Your photo shows the Buffalo, Bear, Deer, Eagle and Flower Set together in the park.

studio.title: Chain reaction

labels.done: You followed the chain from wolves to elk to willows to beavers. Nice work, crew!

studio.look: Real photos of living things in Yellowstone. When one thing changes in an ecosystem, other things can change too. The bars are a model: simple numbers that show what scientists saw. Taller means more. Scientists still study how much the wolves caused.
studio.do: Read the question. Tap More or Fewer to predict. Then tap Run it and read the bars.

frames.lead: 1. How are the living things connected?
frames.starter: When the wolves came back, ___, so ___.

frames.lead: 2. What does this park need to stay healthy?

studio.full: You predicted and ran all 3 charts and picked the claim. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

claim.name: My claim
claim.alt: A gray wolf walking through deep snow
claim.q: What does the chain reaction show?

options.one: 🔗 One kind of animal can change a whole ecosystem.

claim.miss: Look at all three bar charts. Did only the elk change?

wolves.alt: A gray wolf walking through deep snow
wolves.line: 🐺 Wolves came back to Yellowstone in 1995.

chain.name: Elk
chain.alt: A young elk standing in shallow water by tall willows
chain.q: Wolves hunt elk. When wolves come back, will there be more elk or fewer?
chain.why: In the north part of the park, there were fewer elk, and elk moved around more to stay safe.

chain.name: Willows
chain.alt: Yellow willows and trees growing by a river
chain.q: Elk eat young willows by the rivers. With fewer elk, will there be more willows or fewer?
chain.why: In some places by the rivers, willows grew taller because fewer elk ate them.

chain.name: Beavers
chain.alt: A beaver eating plants on a snowy riverbank
chain.q: Beavers eat willows and build with them. With more willows, will there be more beavers or fewer?
chain.why: More beaver families moved in once the willows came back.

studio.allRun: Elk went down. Willows and beavers went up. One change led to another.

voice.brief: Welcome to the park, crew. We film Scene 32, Park Passport. Show me how the living things here need each other.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Tranquil, and pick Tranquil Forest. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set the bison, the bear, the deer, the eagle and the flowers in the park. Then tell me who needs whom, and what.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a big cat that hunts in the mountains. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Predict what happens when wolves come home. Then run it and see.
